question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

It was that cold/ that I could not feel/ my fingers at night.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in the part "**It was that cold**."
 
• The phrase "**It was that cold**" is incorrect and lacks proper grammatical structure. The correct phrasing should be "**It was so cold**" to convey the intended meaning effectively.
 
• The word "**so**" is appropriate for expressing the degree of coldness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 4**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It was so cold that I could not feel my fingers at night."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "that I could not feel"** – This part is grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 2: "my fingers at night."** – This part is grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 3: "No error"** – This would be correct if the sentence contained no errors, but there is an error in **Option 4**.
 
• **Option 4: "It was that cold"** – This part contains the error as explained above.
